name: Wyrm Changeling
description: (Tag:humanoid)(Tag:magic)(Tag:shapeshifter)An eastern dragon that long ago learned to walk on two legs. It keeps a human shape, a scholar's manners, and the strength of a river dragon, and turns between forms in a breath: serpent for war, person for courts, cloud for travel. It serves with the patience of something that expects to outlive your grandchildren.
